text: Scoring changes land in `cli/lib/eval-score.mjs` before any consumer edit, or two machines produce incomparable numbers.
A sentinel added to `cli/lib/eval-score.mjs` needs its anti-zero twin asserted in the same round.
Every model call has to ride `src/relay/governed-turn.ts`, so a direct provider call in a handler is a review stop.
Streamed turns gate the done frame on the audit append inside `src/relay/governed-turn.ts`.
Run every suite under `capbuild` or the shared box swaps itself to death.
A bare vitest under `capbuild` loses its env and executes zero tests, which reads as green.
The gate checklist in `skills/do-arc/SKILL.md` is the one place a new gate slot gets named.
Resuming an arc reads `skills/do-arc/skill.md` first, so a step renamed there has to be renamed in the sidecar too.
Re-read `roadmap/backlog.ts` before editing it, because concurrent sessions move it under you.
